subject.title: [Feature]: SSRF 内网访问确认机制

question: Should OpenClaw add a public browser private-network confirmation/allowlist/temporary-grant policy, and if so which semantics are approved?
rationale: The proposal changes security-sensitive browser/network policy and adds config or approval UX surface, which cannot be safely chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Approve a staged browser SSRF policy
options.body: Define allow/block semantics, non-overridable metadata behavior, timeouts, logging, and upgrade-safe config first, then implement the narrow approved phase.

options.title: Approve interactive confirmation now
options.body: Commit to a user-approval UX with rate limits and session/timeout state across browser navigation paths before implementation.

options.title: Keep current static policy
options.body: Leave browser SSRF as strict default plus explicit host exceptions and broad trusted-environment opt-in, and close only after maintainers decide not to expand core policy.

recommendation.title: Approve a staged browser SSRF policy
recommendation.body: Define allow/block semantics, non-overridable metadata behavior, timeouts, logging, and upgrade-safe config first, then implement the narrow approved phase.
